info.title: Hew Observe HTTP API
info.description: Authoritative contract for the current Hew 0.6 profiler/observe HTTP surface. The Observe wire version is independent of Hew release labels. JSON responses use a strict versioned envelope, and 64-bit integers use canonical decimal strings.

x-hew-transports.tcp: HTTP/1.1 on the configured bind address; the default is loopback-only.
x-hew-transports.unix: HTTP/1.1 over the per-process Unix socket discovered by hew-observe. The socket is mode 0600.

x-hew-evolution.required-properties: Consumers reject missing required properties and properties with the wrong type.
x-hew-evolution.additive-properties: Consumers accept unknown object properties so producers may add fields without a wire-version bump.
x-hew-evolution.open-string-taxonomies: Consumers accept unknown event_type, state, trap_kind, sampling_mode, subject kind, and actor-attribution strings.
x-hew-evolution.breaking-change: Any field, type, unit, taxonomy, or semantic change requires a new Observe wire version.
x-hew-evolution.version-check: Consumers reject an envelope whose schema_version is not exactly v1.

get.description: Reads a non-destructive page from the bounded process trace stream. Omit both cursor parameters to start at the oldest retained event. On subsequent requests, supply both stream_id and after; after is the last sequence already consumed and is therefore exclusive. A full page only means the response limit was reached; has_more and overrun report backlog and loss explicitly.

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.description: Stream epoch from the previous TraceBatch. Must be supplied together with after.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive source sequence cursor from the previous TraceBatch.next_cursor. Must be supplied together with stream_id.

200.description: Prometheus-style scrape text. This endpoint is not JSON and has no schema envelope.

NotFound.description: Unknown paths return status 404 and the literal plain-text body `404 Not Found`. This response is not JSON and has no observe version header.

TraceRequestErrorResponse.description: The trace cursor or page request is malformed or points beyond the current stream.

TraceStreamMismatchResponse.description: The requested stream epoch is no longer current. Consumers must start a new recording segment and must not apply the old cursor to the new stream.

UInt64Decimal.description: Canonical base-10 u64 with no sign or leading zeroes; consumers must enforce the u64 upper bound.

Int64Decimal.description: Canonical base-10 i64 with no plus sign, negative zero, or leading zeroes; consumers must enforce i64 bounds.

Hex128Lower.description: Exactly 128 bits rendered as 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

timestamp_secs.description: Whole monotonic seconds since this metrics ring was created.

rc_live_by_type.description: Live Rc allocation blocks by payload type, including weak-only headers until their final weak owner is released.

id.description: Packed actor id: high 16 bits are the route slot and low 48 bits are the local serial.

route_slot.description: Ephemeral route slot used by the legacy cluster membership subsystem; not a stable NodeId.

last_seen_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the member was last seen, not a timestamp.

peer_route_slot.description: Ephemeral route slot of the peer; not a stable NodeId.

last_activity_ms.description: Monotonic runtime millisecond reading at the last activity.

node_id.description: Stable 128-bit NodeId rendered as lowercase hexadecimal groups.

ActorIdentity.description: Process-local actor identity. Actor id, spawn serial, and a stable dispatch key are captured at event creation; optional display metadata may be resolved from that key during response serialization. Distributed actor identity remains explicitly remote_unknown until the transport carries an exact durable identity.

spawn_serial.description: Full process-local spawn serial, or null when unavailable. Unlike the packed actor id, this value is not truncated.

actor_type.description: Actor type resolved from the event's captured process-local dispatch key; null when unavailable.

TraceSubject.description: Actor subjects require actor details; channel and resource subjects require actor to be null. Unknown future kinds may carry a nullable actor.

kind.description: Open subject taxonomy. Unknown values are forward-compatible.

id.description: Raw process-local identity in the namespace selected by kind.

actor.description: Actor details when kind is actor; otherwise null.

uncertainty_ns.description: Upper bound on uncertainty introduced while sampling this correlation anchor. This does not claim cross-node clock synchronization.

count.description: Inclusive missing range cardinality: last_missing_sequence - first_missing_sequence + 1.

TraceEvent.description: For each actor endpoint, attribution local_actor requires a non-null actor object; external, remote_unknown, and not_applicable require null. Unknown future attribution values remain forward-compatible and may carry a nullable actor.

sequence.description: Strictly increasing within one stream_id; the first assigned sequence is 1.

subject.description: Primary entity whose lifecycle or activity this event describes. Null when no honest subject is known. For send events, source_actor and destination_actor are authoritative.

source_attribution.description: Open attribution taxonomy explaining source_actor nullability without guessing remote identity.

source_actor.description: Sending process-local actor when source_attribution is local_actor; otherwise null for current known attribution values.

destination_attribution.description: Open attribution taxonomy explaining destination_actor nullability without guessing remote identity.

destination_actor.description: Destination process-local actor when destination_attribution is local_actor; otherwise null for current known attribution values.

event_type.description: Open taxonomy. `invalid:<code>` indicates producer corruption; other unknown strings are forward-compatible.

timestamp_ns.description: Nanoseconds since the tracing subsystem epoch. Authoritative for ordering and durations within this producer clock domain; not wall-clock Unix time.

handler_name.description: Selected message handler for destination_actor or an actor subject, or null when not applicable or unavailable.

rc_sweep.description: Actor-terminal Rc survivors consumed exactly once, grouped by payload type. Optional for older producers.

reason.description: Authored interceptor refusal reason. Absent or null for other events and older producers; never returned to a remote caller.

producer_instance_id.description: Random process-lifetime identity. A process restart creates a new value.

stream_id.description: Random trace epoch identity. It changes on trace clear/reset and disable-to-enable transitions.

oldest_sequence.description: Oldest retained sequence, or next_sequence when no event is retained.

next_sequence.description: One past the highest sequence assigned in this stream. It is 1 before any event is assigned.

next_cursor.description: Exclusive after cursor for the next request: the last event returned, or the effective caught-up cursor when events is empty.

has_more.description: True when retained events remain after next_cursor. A page at the response limit does not by itself establish backlog.

overrun.description: Exact events unavailable before this response because retention overwrote them; null when the requested cursor has no gap.

sampling_mode.description: Open sampling taxonomy. Current producers report all or off; consumers accept future modes.

events_recorded_total.description: Events admitted to this stream before retention eviction.

events_overwritten_total.description: Events evicted from this stream's bounded retention ring.

events_sampled_out_total.description: Events rejected by producer sampling. Current all/off producers report zero.

batch_source_monotonic_ns.description: Producer monotonic timestamp sampled for this batch response.

current_producer_instance_id.description: Process identity currently serving this endpoint, so consumers can distinguish a stream reset from a process restart.

time_s.description: Monotonic crash timestamp converted from integer nanoseconds; not Unix time.
